Question: Salaam Dear Mufti Saab My hair is falling and I have used numerous products to stop the hairloss but nothing has worked. I have heard of an oil that helps in Austrailia called Emu oil. Islamically is it permissable to use this product as I am having phsycological problems due to the condition of my hair I hope to hear from you soon. wa salaam Answer ID: 5713 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 766/753=D/1429) If there is an impure agent among the ingredients of the oil, it is not permissible to use it. But if the clothes are not smeared by the oil and you wash it clean at the time of salah then it is allowable though it contains an impure agent. Yes, in case it contains no impure thing then it is absolutely allowed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
